messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the video's camera setup to a full-body shot from a front three-quarter angle. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The woman stands mostly still, shifting her weight slightly and turning her head to look toward the right side of the frame.","camera":"A static, full-body shot from a slightly low angle captures the subject and the surrounding environment.","clothing":"She wears a brown, textured sleeveless crop top, light gray wide-leg trousers, and dark open-toed sandals.","hair_color":"White or platinum blonde.","hairstyle":"Her hair is pulled back into a low ponytail with a few loose strands framing her face.","identity":"A slender young woman with a fair complexion stands in the center of the frame.","scene":"The setting is an outdoor amusement park at dusk, featuring a Ferris wheel on the left and a carousel with string lights on the right."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output is a static full-body front three-quarter shot matching the reference framing, with the woman centered and the amusement-park environment visible. Her clothing changed from a black tank top and light blue jeans with boots to a brown textured crop top, light gray wide-leg trousers, and sandals. Her action changed from walking away, turning, and posing with hands on hips to standing mostly still with only slight weight shifts and head turns. The scene changed from a daytime open plaza with a carousel and distant buildings to a dusk setting with a Ferris wheel on the left and a lit carousel on the right.
arguments.requested_change: Change only the camera to a full-body front three-quarter shot, using the reference for initial viewing direction, subject placement, and framing while preserving the person's appearance, expression, action, scene, and timing.
uncertain: Whether the woman's facial expression was preserved, since the source mostly shows her from behind
unexpected_changes: Person's clothing changed to a brown crop top, gray trousers, and sandals
Person's action changed from walking and posing to standing mostly still
Scene changed to a different amusement-park area with a Ferris wheel and dusk lighting
Camera remains static rather than following the source action progression
